notablePrerequisites: You have Gideon of the Trials' emblem. Gideon of the Trials is on the battlefield, or you control a Gideon planeswalker.
easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 20 or higher.
description:
Cast Transcendence by paying {3}{W}{W}{W}.
Transcendence triggers due to you having 20 or more life. However, you cannot lose the game due to Gideon of the Trials.
Step 2 repeats in an infinite loop, causing the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.
